say:0:1411401001:0.text: Magister, over here! Zanie's been waiting for you!
say:0:1411401001:0.source_cn: 主人，过来这边——祖娅已经等一会儿啦！
say:0:1411401001:0.male: Magister, over here! Zanie's been waiting for you!
say:0:1411401001:0.female: Magister, over here! Zanie's been waiting for you!

say:1:1411402001:1.text: I'm a little nervous. Good thing you came just in time.
say:1:1411402001:1.source_cn: 唔，真有点紧张了，还好你们来得及时。
say:1:1411402001:1.male: I'm a little nervous. Good thing you came just in time.
say:1:1411402001:1.female: I'm a little nervous. Good thing you came just in time.

say:2:1411402002:2.text: What's wrong, Zanie? You seem jittery.
say:2:1411402002:2.source_cn: 怎么了，祖娅？你之前不是接待过伊芙吗？怎么看起来这么紧张？

say:3:1411402003:1.text: Oh, by the way, what did Evie finally decide on for Brimstone Village?
say:3:1411402003:1.source_cn: 对了，还没问你，伊芙那边最后对深岩村定下哪种方案了？

say:4:1411402004:1.text: Her plan isn't that taxing at all. Hyla and I will be handling all the crafting, weapons, and materials—you know, the important stuff. Evie is handling the admin and paperwork, just temporarily.
say:4:1411402004:1.source_cn: 给的方案还是挺宽松的，我和海拉主要负责武器和材料方面的...

say:5:1411402005:1.text: She said that the Empire is insisting she babysit us for a bit. But hey—if we don't blow anything up or start a rebellion, Brimstone gets to run itself again.
say:5:1411402005:1.source_cn: 她说是帝国那边的要求，先由她监管一阵子，没什么问题，就...

choice_prompt:7:1411402005.text: She said that the Empire is insisting she babysit us for a bit. But hey—if we don't blow anything up or start a rebellion, Brimstone gets to run itself again.
choice_prompt:7:1411402005.source_cn: 她说是帝国那边的要求，先由她监管一阵子，没什么问题，就还是交给深岩村自己人来管理。

say:8:1411402006:1.text: I'll admit that she's darn good at her job. Runs things smoother than a greased gearbox. Never thought I'd say this, but she's making us dwarves rethink our stance on paper-pushers.
say:8:1411402006:1.source_cn: 是啊，她处理起日常事务真是又好又快，让不少矮人都对行政...
say:8:1411402006:1.male: I'll admit that she's darn good at her job. Runs things smoother than a greased gearbox. Never thought I'd say this, but she's making us dwarves rethink our stance on paper-pushers.
say:8:1411402006:1.female: I'll admit that she's darn good at her job. Runs things smoother than a greased gearbox. Never thought I'd say this, but she's making us dwarves rethink our stance on paper-pushers.

say:9:1411402008:1.source_cn: 总之，伊芙把弗林遗留下的问题大致处理掉之后，就去帮我们...

choice_prompt:10:1411402008.text: Anyway, Evie pretty much has handled all the disasters that Eldric left behind. Then, she dashed off to sweet-talk the Empire's merchants into working with us again.
choice_prompt:10:1411402008.source_cn: 总之，伊芙把弗林遗留下的问题大致处理掉之后，就去帮我们联络帝国那边的商业渠道了。

say:11:1411402009:1.text: That's the idea. The investor will hopefully fund the village's development and set up trade agreements to secure our future production.
say:11:1411402009:1.source_cn: 算是这个说法。要说做生意，第一选择肯定是秘银商会，但伊...
say:11:1411402009:1.male: That's the idea. The investor will hopefully fund the village's development and set up trade agreements to secure our future production.
say:11:1411402009:1.female: That's the idea. The investor will hopefully fund the village's development and set up trade agreements to secure our future production.

say:12:1411402010:1.text: The investor Evie found is supposedly more suitable for Brimstone Village. He usually does venture capital investments and also has his own channels for buying and selling.

say:13:1411402011:1.text: Evie was supposed to join us today, but she had to zip back to the Imperial capital for some urgent business.
say:13:1411402011:1.source_cn: 今天本来她会陪我们接待的，但说是帝都有事，她先回去了。

say:14:1411402012:1.text: Hyla's terrible with strangers, so I asked you to step in.
say:14:1411402012:1.source_cn: 海拉一跟外人说话就发怵，没办法，我只好拜托你们来搭把手。
say:14:1411402012:1.male: Hyla's terrible with strangers, so I asked you to step in.
say:14:1411402012:1.female: Hyla's terrible with strangers, so I asked you to step in.

say:20:1411402017:1.text: He's called <style="highlight">Baelran</style>. I heard he's a middle-aged man who's easy to talk to.
say:20:1411402017:1.source_cn: 只知道他的名字叫<style=highlight>巴赫...

say:22:1411402019:1.text: I have some time left to memorize and practice my greetings.
say:22:1411402019:1.source_cn: 我也正好背背伊芙教我的那些接待套话。

say:24:1411402015:1.text: I'm sure things will be fine! The Magister can handle anything!
say:24:1411402015:1.source_cn: 嗯！主人无论什么事都能处理得非常完美！我也应该相信主人才对！
say:24:1411402015:1.male: I'm sure things will be fine! The Magister can handle anything!
say:24:1411402015:1.female: I'm sure things will be fine! The Magister can handle anything!

choice:17:1:2.female: Negotiations are a piece of cake!

choice:7:0:1.female: She has her own duties after all.

say:25:1411402007:1.text: None! Dwarves generally hate administrative work and the like. Even our accounting is usually done by someone else...
say:25:1411402007:1.source_cn: 完全没有！矮人们还是普遍对行政工作有偏见，连会计都是找...
say:25:1411402007:1.male: None! Dwarves generally hate administrative work and the like. Even our accounting is usually done by someone else...

choice:7:1:2.male: Anyone among you who can supervise?
choice:7:1:2.female: Anyone among you who can supervise?

say:0:1411403101:0.source_cn: 往这边走吧，先去参观下我们采矿的环境。

say:1:1411405001:0.text: That took a while. The earthquake must've spooked them, and they ran out here. Luckily, we were here to stop them.
say:1:1411405001:0.source_cn: 总算击退了，恐怕是被地震吓得跑出来的，这么没头没尾地乱撞。

say:5:1411405003:0.text: No cracks in the walls or floor, and there was little debris.
say:5:1411405003:0.source_cn: 地面和墙壁也没有裂缝，碎石影响也不大。

say:6:1411405004:0.text: There was a lot of shaking, though. How are the miners inside?
say:6:1411405004:0.source_cn: 只是刚刚摇晃得太厉害了，里头的矿工会不会有什么问题？

say:7:1411405005:0.text: Our miners are experienced and have been through earthquakes before, but that one was way too sudden...
say:7:1411405005:0.source_cn: 这里的矿工经验丰富，应该知道怎么躲避，只是这地震也太突...

say:8:1411405006:0.text: Let's go inside and take a look then. If someone needs help, I can lend a hand.
say:8:1411405006:0.source_cn: 以防万一，我们赶紧进去看看吧，万一有事，我也好搭把手。

say:9:1411405007:0.text: I can't possibly ask you to help. You're here on business...
say:9:1411405007:0.source_cn: 这、这怎么行，你们是来商务考察的……

say:10:1411405008:0.text: We're wasting time. Didn't you say you wanted our cooperation to be more straightforward?
say:10:1411405008:0.source_cn: 别浪费时间了，祖娅，你不是说过，讨厌那些弯弯绕绕的交涉...

say:11:1411405009:0.text: When there's a disaster, every hand is needed. Let's go.
say:11:1411405009:0.source_cn: 多个人多份力，救灾要及时，我们快走吧。

say:1:1411407001:0.text: That earthquake came too fast. Ugh! My knee...
say:1:1411407001:0.source_cn: 怎么突然就地震了，哎哟哟，我的膝盖……

say:4:1411407003:1.text: I'm fine. As soon as the earthquake hit, I dropped to the floor. It's just that I didn't stabilize myself and ended up hitting my knee.
say:4:1411407003:1.source_cn: 没事没事，刚一摇晃我立刻就趴下了，只是一下没趴稳，结果...

say:6:1411407004:1.text: It doesn't make sense. There was no warning. Strange...
say:6:1411407004:1.source_cn: 按理说不应该啊，完全没有先兆，太古怪了……

choice_prompt:7:1411407004.text: It doesn't make sense. There was no warning. Strange...
choice_prompt:7:1411407004.source_cn: 按理说不应该啊，完全没有先兆，太古怪了……

say:8:1411407005:1.text: Before an earthquake hits, there's usually a cracking sound that can be heard in the tunnels.
say:8:1411407005:1.source_cn: 你们不懂，地震之前，大地会先咯吱咯吱地提醒我们的！
say:8:1411407005:1.male: Before an earthquake hits, there's usually a cracking sound that can be heard in the tunnels.
say:8:1411407005:1.female: Before an earthquake hits, there's usually a cracking sound that can be heard in the tunnels.

say:9:1411407007:1.text: But this earthquake came out of nowhere. Bam! It doesn't seem like a normal one.
say:9:1411407007:1.source_cn: 可是这次的地震，就轰！啪！然后就开始摇个不停，根本不像...

say:10:1411407008:1.text: If it were normal, I wouldn't have gotten hurt... Ugh!
say:10:1411407008:1.source_cn: 要不是这样，我也不会受伤……哎哟哟哟。

choice_prompt:11:1411407008.text: If it were normal, I wouldn't have gotten hurt... Ugh!
choice_prompt:11:1411407008.source_cn: 要不是这样，我也不会受伤……哎哟哟哟。

say:12:1411407009:1.text: I didn't hurt my kneecap or any bones. It's just a big scrape...
say:12:1411407009:1.source_cn: 就是这里，骨头应该没事，就是擦伤了一大片，哎哟哟……
say:12:1411407009:1.male: I didn't hurt my kneecap or any bones. It's just a big scrape...
say:12:1411407009:1.female: I didn't hurt my kneecap or any bones. It's just a big scrape...

say:14:1411407006:1.text: Earthquakes usually give warning signs. Sometimes even half an hour in advance.
say:14:1411407006:1.source_cn: 因为一点迹象都没有啊！以前的地震，我们提前半个小时就能...
say:14:1411407006:1.male: Earthquakes usually give warning signs. Sometimes even half an hour in advance.
say:14:1411407006:1.female: Earthquakes usually give warning signs. Sometimes even half an hour in advance.

say:1:1411407101:0.text: Whoa! Was that magic?! It doesn't hurt at all now!
say:1:1411407101:0.source_cn: 这是魔法吗？！太神奇了，我的伤口一点都不疼了！
say:1:1411407101:0.male: Whoa! Was that magic?! It doesn't hurt at all now!
say:1:1411407101:0.female: Whoa! Was that magic?! It doesn't hurt at all now!

say:2:1411407102:0.text: Thank you so much! I still need to rest for a bit, though. My legs feel weak.
say:2:1411407102:0.source_cn: 谢谢你，不过我还得再坐一会儿，腿还是有些软。
say:2:1411407102:0.male: Thank you so much! I still need to rest for a bit, though. My legs feel weak.
say:2:1411407102:0.female: Thank you so much! I still need to rest for a bit, though. My legs feel weak.

say:4:1411407103:0.text: Don't stay too long. There may be aftershocks. Is there anyone else nearby?
say:4:1411407103:0.source_cn: 别待太久，很可能还会发生余震。对了，这附近还有别人吗？

say:5:1411407104:1.text: Yeah, there are some other dwarves down here. I saw someone lose their balance and fall down.
say:5:1411407104:1.source_cn: 有吧，挺多的人的，我刚还看到有人一下没站稳，摔在地上滚...

say:6:1411407105:1.text: I think some rocks landed on someone. I heard some screaming over there.
say:6:1411407105:1.source_cn: 还有人躲到角落去，被石头砸了下脑袋，嗷嗷叫个不停。

say:7:1411407106:1.text: But the majority of us were able to escape.
say:7:1411407106:1.source_cn: 不过都没什么大事，跑出来的和像我这样摔倒的还是占多数。

say:8:1411407107:1.text: Don't worry. The overseer will arrange a rescue team later. We're dwarves. We know what to do in our mines.
say:8:1411407107:1.source_cn: 队长等会儿也会安排人救助的，你们不用担心，矿洞可是我们...

say:9:1411407108:1.text: Alright. Have your overseer report any issues to me. I can allocate more manpower.
say:9:1411407108:1.source_cn: 好，记得和你们队长说，要做好登记，有什么问题随时找我汇报！

say:0:1411409001:0.text: The miners over there seem to be injured by the earthquake. Let's go and check on them.
say:0:1411409001:0.source_cn: 那边的矿工看起来因为地震的冲击受伤了，快去看看情况吧。

say:0:1411409501:0.text: The toolbox fell over, and the whole place is a mess... Let's clean up a bit.
say:0:1411409501:0.source_cn: 工具箱好像倒了，掉得到处都是……我们收拾下吧。

say:0:1411410001:0.text: We've tidied up here. Let's look elsewhere.
say:0:1411410001:0.source_cn: 这边收拾好了，地面平整，后续也好进出，我们调查别处吧。

say:1:1411412001:0.text: Why does it hurt so much...? And why am I dizzy...?

say:3:1411412002:1.text: You passed out. How are you feeling now?
say:3:1411412002:1.source_cn: 刚刚你昏倒了，现在怎么样，好点了吗？

say:4:1411412003:1.text: Oh, yeah... During the earthquake, I think a bunch of rocks came down on me.
say:4:1411412003:1.source_cn: 昏倒……哦，对，没错，刚刚地震的时候，突然掉下一块碎石。

say:6:1411412004:1.text: I wasn't wearing my helmet, and one hit me right on the head. I passed out after that.
say:6:1411412004:1.source_cn: 我没戴头盔，被它砸到脑门上，一下就失去意识了。

choice_prompt:7:1411412004.text: I wasn't wearing my helmet, and one hit me right on the head. I passed out after that.
choice_prompt:7:1411412004.source_cn: 我没戴头盔，被它砸到脑门上，一下就失去意识了。

say:8:1411412005:1.text: I've been working in these mines for years without a helmet. Who knew an earthquake would hit out of nowhere...
say:8:1411412005:1.source_cn: 矿洞都这么多年了，不戴头盔也好好的，谁能想到最近会突然...
say:8:1411412005:1.male: I've been working in these mines for years without a helmet. Who knew an earthquake would hit out of nowhere...
say:8:1411412005:1.female: I've been working in these mines for years without a helmet. Who knew an earthquake would hit out of nowhere...

say:9:1411412007:1.text: This reminds me... Before the earthquake hit, I heard <style="highlight">a rumbling sound</style>.
say:9:1411412007:1.source_cn: 说起来，地震前，我老能听见<style=highlig...

say:10:1411412008:1.text: I don't know if it was real, or if I've just been in this cave so long I'm starting to hear things.
say:10:1411412008:1.source_cn: 也不知道到底是真有这个动静，还是我在洞里待久了耳鸣了……

say:14:1411412010:1.text: Yeah, sit down for a bit. The walls here are stable. There shouldn't be any more loose rocks about.
say:14:1411412010:1.source_cn: 嗯，你先在这边坐一会儿，这里比较空旷，岩壁也结实，不会...

say:15:1411412011:1.text: You should leave and head for safety as soon as you recover a bit. If you can't leave on your own, the rescue team will come and haul you out of here.
say:15:1411412011:1.source_cn: 等缓过来就尽快撤离，要是实在难受，等下组织撤离的时候会...

say:16:1411412012:1.text: Also, remember to protect your head next time! You've only got one!
say:16:1411412012:1.source_cn: 还有，下次一定记得工作时要保护好脑袋！

say:17:1411412013:1.text: Got it. I'll definitely wear my helmet next time.
say:17:1411412013:1.source_cn: 知道了知道了，这次一定记住！

say:19:1411412006:1.text: I haven't seen any earthquakes in these mines for years, but recently it's been shaking a bit.
say:19:1411412006:1.source_cn: 这么多年都没见过矿洞有地震，就这段时间时不时会摇下。
say:19:1411412006:1.male: I haven't seen any earthquakes in these mines for years, but recently it's been shaking a bit.
say:19:1411412006:1.female: I haven't seen any earthquakes in these mines for years, but recently it's been shaking a bit.

say:1:1411413001:1.text: Fortunately, there were a few minor injuries. Most people were just startled.
say:1:1411413001:1.source_cn: 还好还好，没有重伤，只有几个轻伤的，大部分人只是被吓了一跳。

say:2:1411413002:1.text: And the mine didn't collapse. Only some loose rocks came down.
say:2:1411413002:1.source_cn: 矿洞也几乎完好无损，最多就是有一点点碎石。

say:3:1411413003:1.text: Still, we'll call a temporary stop to work, just in case.
say:3:1411413003:1.source_cn: 以防万一，我已经通知停工了。

say:5:1411413004:1.text: Yes, losing one or two days isn't going to matter in the grand scheme of things. Safety always comes first.
say:5:1411413004:1.source_cn: 嗯，不差这么一两天的工期，安全生产才是第一位。

say:6:1411413005:1.text: But the quaking was severe just now... and that dwarf said he heard a strange rumbling noise.
say:6:1411413005:1.source_cn: 只不过，刚刚摇晃得那么严重，又有人说听到下方轰隆作响……

choice_prompt:7:1411413005.text: But the quaking was severe just now... and that dwarf said he heard a strange rumbling noise.
choice_prompt:7:1411413005.source_cn: 只不过，刚刚摇晃得那么严重，又有人说听到下方轰隆作响……

say:8:1411413006:1.text: Yes, if the tremors here were so strong, Sal'thorin may be even more affected.
say:8:1411413006:1.source_cn: 是，我们在上方震感都这么强烈，萨洛克兰矿区恐怕受影响更严重。
say:8:1411413006:1.male: Yes, if the tremors here were so strong, Sal'thorin may be even more affected.
say:8:1411413006:1.female: Yes, if the tremors here were so strong, Sal'thorin may be even more affected.

say:9:1411413008:1.text: I have to go down and notify everyone in the Sal'thorin mines to stop work as well.
say:9:1411413008:1.source_cn: 就算没问题，已经地震了，我也得下去通知下下面一起停工。

say:10:1411413009:1.text: I'll come with you. I want to check out the underground mines with my own eyes.
say:10:1411413009:1.source_cn: 那我们就一起进去看看情况吧，我正好也可以亲眼目睹一下地...

say:11:1411413010:1.text: If anything's wrong, I'll help however I can.
say:11:1411413010:1.source_cn: 万一有什么问题，我这边提供支援也能更及时和准确。

choice_prompt:12:1411413010.text: If anything's wrong, I'll help however I can.
choice_prompt:12:1411413010.source_cn: 万一有什么问题，我这边提供支援也能更及时和准确。

say:13:1411413011:1.text: It doesn't always have to be money and business, Merlin. Besides, Celestials don't actually need money and gold in their everyday lives.

say:44:1411418035:1.female: Really?! I even bought the latest fashions and redid my hair!

say:46:1411418037:1.text: Wait... Don't Hypogeans usually use magic to conjure up their clothes?
say:46:1411418037:1.source_cn: ……通常来说，我是说通常来说，恶魔应该是用自己的魔力幻...

say:47:1411418038:2.text: Yes, this is common knowledge. Even Chippy knows that, and he can barely read!
say:47:1411418038:2.source_cn: 是啊，这可是连满满都知道的常识！

say:48:1411418039:1.text: Also, Hypogeans don't really have an image to uphold.
say:48:1411418039:1.source_cn: 而且，与其说是幻化服装，许多强大的恶魔，根本就没有自己...

say:49:1411418040:1.text: Berial was always shapeshifting. The only reason he stuck with that clown appearance was because he believed that it fit his twisted sense of humor.
say:49:1411418040:1.source_cn: 比如贝利尔，就是变幻万千的影子，那个小丑模样，只是他认...

say:50:1411418041:1.text: As for that red Hypogean, he's even better at making people see what they want to see. His illusions felt like reality...
say:50:1411418041:1.source_cn: 至于那个猩红的恶魔，他更擅长把自己的形象投射在观者的眼...

say:51:1411418042:1.text: Only Celestials and the Magister could see through his tricks.
say:51:1411418042:1.source_cn: 恐怕只有主人和半神们，才能透过他投射的迷雾看清他的本体。
say:51:1411418042:1.male: Only Celestials and the Magister could see through his tricks.
say:51:1411418042:1.female: Only Celestials and the Magister could see through his tricks.

say:52:1411418043:1.text: Oh, Chippy knows what's going on! You don't have the magic to change your appearance, do you?!
say:52:1411418043:1.source_cn: 哼哼，我知道了！你根本就没有改变形象的魔力吧，小丫头！

say:53:1411418044:1.text: What did you say?! I just like the latest fashions, alright?
say:53:1411418044:1.source_cn: 你说、说什么，我只是想要更时尚——

say:55:1411418045:1.text: Is this some sort of rebellious teenage behavior among Hypogeans? Using money on clothing is kind of wasteful...
say:55:1411418045:1.source_cn: 连衣服都要花钱买，对恶魔来说，倒也是一种叛逆行为。

say:56:1411418046:1.text: Or is it because you don't have enough power to conjure up clothing or illusions?
say:56:1411418046:1.source_cn: 是因为力量不够，所以只能通过这些表面的行为来呈现自己的...

say:57:1411418047:1.text: <shk>Shut up!</shk> You're a bunch of jerks! How dare you speak to me like this?!

say:58:1411418048:1.text: Boomboom, let's teach them a lesson!
say:58:1411418048:1.source_cn: 阿爆，我们一起，给他们点颜色看看！

say:60:1411418049:1.text: Oh-ho, Lady Kulu is about to blow a gasket! Okay! Time for me to show my stuff!
say:60:1411418049:1.source_cn: 哦哦哦！库露露大人的怒火，如此燃烧！阿爆一定会制造出漂...

say:62:1411418050:1.text: Regardless of the explosion's size, its destructive power remains quite limited, and the level of magical corruption is almost absurd.
say:62:1411418050:1.source_cn: 再怎样爆炸，威力也仅限于此，甚至连魔力的腐败程度都令人发噱。

say:63:1411418051:1.text: What? Stop using such big words!
say:63:1411418051:1.source_cn: 什、什么发……那个词是什么意思啊？！

say:65:1411418052:1.text: Forcing yourself to become a villain and trying to trigger a boss battle that you can't win is a waste of everyone's time.
say:65:1411418052:1.source_cn: 强行扮演反派，增加这种注定会被击败的所谓“剧情战”，是...

say:66:1411418053:1.text: What does that mean?! Are you treating this like a scripted play?! Why are you calling this a boss battle?!
say:66:1411418053:1.source_cn: 什么意思啊！你在把我当戏看吗！还有剧情战是什么意思啊！

say:67:1411418054:1.text: You need anger to set off your bombs, huh? But even your anger is unstable.
say:67:1411418054:1.source_cn: 需要怒火才能引发炸弹，但连愤怒的情绪都如此不稳定。

say:68:1411418055:1.text: She seems all over the place and weaker than Baelran, but her strength is incomparable.
say:68:1411418055:1.source_cn: 随时会被转移，随时会改变，比巴赫朗还更加软弱，但力量却...

say:70:1411418056:1.text: Why do you two always have to involve me?
say:70:1411418056:1.source_cn: ……喂，这种时候就别扯上我了吧。

say:71:1411418057:1.text: *Sigh*... Young lady, your bombs may not be powerful and didn't cause a lot of damage, but your behavior is reckless and dangerous.
say:71:1411418057:1.source_cn: 小姑娘，你的炸弹威力很小，并没有造成什么过大的伤害，但...

say:72:1411418058:1.text: There's no point in us fighting. Why don't we sit down, calm down, and have a good talk?
say:72:1411418058:1.source_cn: 我不愿和你战斗，反复作战也毫无意义，不如坐下好好谈谈？

say:73:1411418059:1.text: Tell us, why have you been behaving this way?
say:73:1411418059:1.source_cn: 我想更了解你一些，你为什么会来这里，为什么会做这些，还...

say:74:1411418060:1.text: <shk>Ahhh! I can't take this anymore!</shk> Why are you talking to me like that?!

say:75:1411418061:1.text: I am a powerful Hypogean! I am the ultimate darkness! The queen of explosions!
say:75:1411418061:1.source_cn: 我是强大无比的恶魔！我是最极限的黑暗！邪恶的爆炸！伟大...

say:76:1411418062:1.text: How dare you talk to me like I'm a child?! It's time to show you what I can do! Boomboom! Get them!
say:76:1411418062:1.source_cn: 你们居然敢说我弱小！我就让你们尝尝，什么叫爆炸的滋味！...

say:80:1411418036:1.text: An old bag like you knows nothing! This is the latest fashion in the Lightbearer Empire!
say:80:1411418036:1.source_cn: 老、老古董知道什么！这是耀光的流行，我在过来之前特意买...
say:80:1411418036:1.male: An old bag like you knows nothing! This is the latest fashion in the Lightbearer Empire!
say:80:1411418036:1.female: An old bag like you knows nothing! This is the latest fashion in the Lightbearer Empire!

choice:43:1:2.text: Look at your hair and outfit...
choice:43:1:2.male: Look at your hair and outfit...
choice:43:1:2.female: Look at your hair and outfit...

say:81:1411418005:1.text: That's right! I'm Lady Kulu's number one familiar, Boomboom!
say:81:1411418005:1.source_cn: 没错，我正是尊贵伟大的库露露大人的首席炸弹使魔，得到了...
say:81:1411418005:1.male: That's right! I'm Lady Kulu's number one familiar, Boomboom!
say:81:1411418005:1.female: That's right! I'm Lady Kulu's number one familiar, Boomboom!

say:82:1411418006:1.text: If you don't want to get blown up, you better hightail it out of here. Oh! Are you a mage?
say:82:1411418006:1.source_cn: 知道厉害就趁早——是、是魔法师？！
say:82:1411418006:1.male: If you don't want to get blown up, you better hightail it out of here. Oh! Are you a mage?
say:82:1411418006:1.female: If you don't want to get blown up, you better hightail it out of here. Oh! Are you a mage?

narration:0:1411419501:1.text: Clearing the area takes some effort, and by the time you finish, Kulu is already gone—vanished into the mines on that rickety old cart.

narration:1:1411419502:1.text: You have no choice but to chase after the minecart...

say:0:1411420001:0.text: They placed bombs along our path. Let's disarm them first.
say:0:1411420001:0.source_cn: 沿途都被布上了炸弹，安全起见，还是先解除掉吧。
say:0:1411420001:0.male: They placed bombs along our path. Let's disarm them first.
say:0:1411420001:0.female: They placed bombs along our path. Let's disarm them first.

say:0:1411421001:0.text: Alright, all the bombs have been defused.
say:0:1411421001:0.source_cn: 好，这一带的炸弹应该都被解除了。
say:0:1411421001:0.male: Alright, all the bombs have been defused.
say:0:1411421001:0.female: Alright, all the bombs have been defused.

say:1:1411421002:0.text: As expected of Merlin. These Hypogean bombs didn't stand a chance.
say:1:1411421002:0.source_cn: 不愧是梅林的手笔，连恶魔留下的炸弹处理得都这么举重若轻。
say:1:1411421002:0.male: As expected of Merlin. These Hypogean bombs didn't stand a chance.
say:1:1411421002:0.female: As expected of Merlin. These Hypogean bombs didn't stand a chance.

say:0:1411421101:0.text: There are more bombs over here!
say:0:1411421101:0.source_cn: 这里居然也布置了炸弹！
say:0:1411421101:0.male: There are more bombs over here!
say:0:1411421101:0.female: There are more bombs over here!

say:0:1411421201:0.text: These are taken care of... I really hope that's the last of them.
say:0:1411421201:0.source_cn: 已经都解除干净了，希望别的地方没有被布下……
say:0:1411421201:0.male: These are taken care of... I really hope that's the last of them.
say:0:1411421201:0.female: These are taken care of... I really hope that's the last of them.

say:1:1411421202:0.text: We have to stop her! Leaving bombs lying around is way too dangerous!
say:1:1411421202:0.source_cn: 必须得阻止她！到处布置这种炸弹，简直太危险了！
say:1:1411421202:0.male: We have to stop her! Leaving bombs lying around is way too dangerous!
say:1:1411421202:0.female: We have to stop her! Leaving bombs lying around is way too dangerous!

say:0:1411422001:0.text: Wait a minute! There are two miners trapped over there!
say:0:1411422001:0.source_cn: 等一下，那边好像有两个矿工被困住了。
say:0:1411422001:0.male: Wait a minute! There are two miners trapped over there!
say:0:1411422001:0.female: Wait a minute! There are two miners trapped over there!

say:1:1411424001:1.text: I just heard another explosion. Are you guys alright?
say:1:1411424001:1.source_cn: 刚刚我又听见爆炸声了，你们还好吗？

say:2:1411424002:1.text: We're fine. It was that Hypo... I mean, little girl that's been causing all the trouble.
say:2:1411424002:1.source_cn: 没事，是那个恶魔……我是说那个小丫头干的。

say:3:1411424003:1.text: Oh, so you've met Kulu, huh?
say:3:1411424003:1.source_cn: 哦？你们也碰上库露露了吗？

choice_prompt:4:1411424003.text: Oh, so you've met Kulu, huh?
choice_prompt:4:1411424003.source_cn: 哦？你们也碰上库露露了吗？

say:5:1411424004:1.text: She's become well-known among our crew these past two days. Everyone likes her.
say:5:1411424004:1.source_cn: 她这两天在我们这很出名啊！毕竟她性格挺好的。
say:5:1411424004:1.male: She's become well-known among our crew these past two days. Everyone likes her.
say:5:1411424004:1.female: She's become well-known among our crew these past two days. Everyone likes her.

say:7:1411424006:1.text: Yeah, most of the pointy-eared tall folk are too uppity. They think their farts don't stink.
say:7:1411424006:1.source_cn: 是啊，你也见过那帮尖耳朵吧？一个个装腔作势拿腔拿调的。

say:8:1411424007:1.text: But Kulu? She's honest, sharp, and actually asks questions when she doesn't get something. People warmed up to her fast.
say:8:1411424007:1.source_cn: 但是那小丫头就很直率，又开朗，不懂的也会问，大家都挺喜...

say:11:1411424009:1.text: Come to think of it, when everyone was arguing with Kulu just now, Zanie didn't say anything.
say:11:1411424009:1.source_cn: 说起来，刚刚跟库露露吵架的时候，祖娅居然一句话都没说。

say:12:1411424010:1.text: Kids that age are headaches. They're loud and rebellious. They never listen to anything you say and think they're the best in the world.
say:12:1411424010:1.source_cn: 我最头疼这个年龄段的小孩了，又叛逆，又闹腾，说什么都不...

say:13:1411424011:1.text: But you look the same age as her...

say:14:1411424012:1.text: Yeah, and don't you know why I look like this?
say:14:1411424012:1.source_cn: 唉，你看我长这样还不明白？

say:15:1411424013:0.text: When I was her age, I was messing around and accidentally drank some dragon egg essence. Now I'll look like this forever.
say:15:1411424013:0.source_cn: 我在当年那个年纪要是好惹，会误喝龙蛋清让自己变成这模样吗？

choice_prompt:16:1411424013.text: When I was her age, I was messing around and accidentally drank some dragon egg essence. Now I'll look like this forever.
choice_prompt:16:1411424013.source_cn: 我在当年那个年纪要是好惹，会误喝龙蛋清让自己变成这模样吗？

say:17:1411424014:1.text: But you guys were getting along just fine. So why'd she go wild with the bombs?
say:17:1411424014:1.source_cn: 所以，你们之前既然相处得不错，那库露露为什么会翻脸扔炸弹？

say:19:1411424015:1.text: Well, she told us she was good with explosions—showed us, even. She really was amazing at it!
say:19:1411424015:1.source_cn: 是这样，我们跟库露露聊天，她说她很擅长爆炸，给我们表演...

say:20:1411424016:1.text: We asked her to help blow open some blocked tunnels, but when we tried blasting a new one, things went wrong.
say:20:1411424016:1.source_cn: 我们就托她接着帮忙炸几个地方，结果就之前开一处新矿山的...

say:21:1411424017:1.text: As a result, half of the mountain fell off, and work had to be stopped. Several dwarves were injured.
say:21:1411424017:1.source_cn: 结果轰！的一声，整座山掉了半个头，结果不得不停工，还有...

say:22:1411424018:1.text: That sounds like an accident. She didn't mean for it to happen...
say:22:1411424018:1.source_cn: 这……听起来像是事故，不太像是故意的啊？

say:23:1411424019:1.text: Yeah, we know. Everyone tried to reassure her, but then she snapped.
say:23:1411424019:1.source_cn: 谁说不是呢，大家还安慰她，结果她反而恼火了！

say:24:1411424020:1.text: She started saying things like "I'm very evil!" and "I did it on purpose!", and started dropping bombs everywhere.
say:24:1411424020:1.source_cn: 突然说什么“我就是故意炸的！”“我很邪恶！我要炸烂所有...

say:25:1411424021:1.text: It's hard to explain... She's acting out, yeah, but she doesn't feel truly evil.
say:25:1411424021:1.source_cn: ……该怎么说呢，确实是在做坏事，但感觉和邪恶好像关系不大……

say:26:1411424022:1.text: Yeah, we know that. Compared to us, she's just a baby. Her bombs aren't that scary anyway.
say:26:1411424022:1.source_cn: 哎，谁说不是，不就是小女孩儿要面子嘛！她那点炸弹威力也...

say:27:1411424023:1.text: Next to those dainty pointy-eared maidens who gasp at a single curse, a little fire in her feels downright refreshing. Deep down, she's got a good heart.
say:27:1411424023:1.source_cn: 而且跟那些说错句话就皱眉头的尖耳朵比，她发个小脾气也挺...

say:28:1411424024:1.text: Anyway, there was some rubble, and this fella hurt his leg. We need to rest here for a bit before we can move on...
say:28:1411424024:1.source_cn: 就是刚刚这边有碎石，不小心把这家伙的腿给弄伤了，只能在...

choice_prompt:29:1411424024.text: Anyway, there was some rubble, and this fella hurt his leg. We need to rest here for a bit before we can move on...
choice_prompt:29:1411424024.source_cn: 就是刚刚这边有碎石，不小心把这家伙的腿给弄伤了，只能在这歇会儿……

say:30:1411424025:1.text: Once you're all healed up, evacuate the area. It's still dangerous here.
say:30:1411424025:1.source_cn: 嗯，治好伤你们就尽快撤离，无论如何，这附近还比较危险。

say:0:1411426001:0.text: No matter her motives, we can't let her continue. Let's hurry after her!
say:0:1411426001:0.source_cn: 幼稚也好邪恶也罢，不能让她继续胡闹了，我们快点去追吧！

say:0:1411426101:0.text: Everything looks broken... I need to check what still works.
say:0:1411426101:0.source_cn: 设备东倒西歪的……我得去看看坏了多少！

say:0:1411426201:1.text: Upon closer look, the equipment appears scattered, but the damage is minimal.
say:0:1411426201:1.source_cn: 经过检查，你们发现这些设备虽然散乱，但只是轻微损伤。

say:1:1411426202:0.text: The upheaval here seems to have come from the trembling earth itself, not the aftermath of any blast or fire.
say:1:1411426202:0.source_cn: 似乎是因为地震导致的翻倒，并没有遭遇爆炸的痕迹。

say:0:1411426301:1.text: Loose rocks and bits of rubble cover the area, and also a lot of dust.
say:0:1411426301:1.source_cn: 地面到处都是碎石，有些甚至已经变成了粉末。

say:1:1411426302:1.text: It seems the blast here was fairly contained in both reach and strength.
say:1:1411426302:1.source_cn: 但能看得出来，爆炸范围和威力总体而言相当有限。

say:1:1411426401:1.text: The damage she caused was minimal. Most people were just startled, and the injuries were minor.
say:1:1411426401:1.source_cn: 呼，整体看来，她造成的影响有限，大部分人只是受惊，受伤...

say:2:1411426402:1.text: The equipment wasn't damaged either, just knocked over by the quake. So, overall, it's not too bad.
say:2:1411426402:1.source_cn: 设备也没有受到损失，都是因为地震和爆炸导致的翻倒，基本...

say:3:1411426403:1.text: She clearly avoided hitting people or critical gear—focused her blasts on the tunnels and surrounding areas.
say:3:1411426403:1.source_cn: 她似乎有意避开人和昂贵的设备，主要都是在炸各种通道和周...

say:4:1411426404:1.text: If she were just a kid, you'd call this mischief. But a Hypogean? Honestly, she's holding back.
say:4:1411426404:1.source_cn: 如果她只是个小女孩，那胡闹得确实有点过分，但对恶魔来说...

say:6:1411426405:1.text: Maybe she's only holding back because she isn't at full power yet.
say:6:1411426405:1.source_cn: 或许是因为她现在实力有限。

say:7:1411426406:1.text: In any case, our losses are still manageable for now, but we can't afford to let her roam free. Let's go after her.
say:7:1411426406:1.source_cn: 总之，万幸目前损失不大，但我们也不能对她放任不管，继续...

say:1:1411427001:1.text: She's not here either... That kid's quicker than she looks.
say:1:1411427001:1.source_cn: 到了这里还不见人影……她跑得也太快了。

say:2:1411427002:1.text: Sorry, everyone. Can I leave the Hypogean to you? I don't have time to keep chasing her.
say:2:1411427002:1.source_cn: 抱歉，各位，追捕恶魔的事能交给你们吗？我可能没法继续追击了。

choice_prompt:3:1411427002.text: Sorry, everyone. Can I leave the Hypogean to you? I don't have time to keep chasing her.
choice_prompt:3:1411427002.source_cn: 抱歉，各位，追捕恶魔的事能交给你们吗？我可能没法继续追击了。

say:4:1411427003:1.text: Yeah, she caused more confusion than real harm, but the best thing I can do now is calm things down.
say:4:1411427003:1.source_cn: 是的，她造成的混乱比损失大，现在最重要的是先平息事态。
say:4:1411427003:1.male: Yeah, she caused more confusion than real harm, but the best thing I can do now is calm things down.
say:4:1411427003:1.female: Yeah, she caused more confusion than real harm, but the best thing I can do now is calm things down.

say:5:1411427005:1.text: I need to repair and set up the equipment, coordinate the miners' evacuation, and tend to the injured.
say:5:1411427005:1.source_cn: 我得留在这边先整备装备，组织起躲藏的矿工，救助伤员。

say:6:1411427006:1.text: And someone has to notify Sal'thorin. Indris and Ravion need to be looped in.
say:6:1411427006:1.source_cn: 而且还有一点，得去萨洛克兰通知因度厄和沙利叶他们。

say:7:1411427007:1.text: A Hypogean showing up and these accidents happening on their land... There's no way we can let that go unreported.
say:7:1411427007:1.source_cn: 在他们的地盘上出现了恶魔和这样的事故，总不能瞒着负责人。

choice_prompt:8:1411427007.text: A Hypogean showing up and these accidents happening on their land... There's no way we can let that go unreported.
choice_prompt:8:1411427007.source_cn: 在他们的地盘上出现了恶魔和这样的事故，总不能瞒着负责人。

say:9:1411427008:1.text:
I certainly hope so.
Baelran, I'm truly sorry. We'll have to put the contract on hold for now.

say:27:1411404025:1.text: For a Celestial to forget one's duties and care only for mortal affairs is the epitome of failure.
say:27:1411404025:1.source_cn: 作为半神，忘却本职，只关心人间的事务，已经很失败了。
say:27:1411404025:1.male: For a Celestial to forget one's duties and care only for mortal affairs is the epitome of failure.
say:27:1411404025:1.female: For a Celestial to forget one's duties and care only for mortal affairs is the epitome of failure.

say:28:1411404026:1.text: And if he did not succeed at all in the mortal realm, then he'd be a failure times two.
say:28:1411404026:1.source_cn: 如果在人间的事务上还无法取得成功，那才是失败中的失败。
say:28:1411404026:1.male: And if he did not succeed at all in the mortal realm, then he'd be a failure times two.
say:28:1411404026:1.female: And if he did not succeed at all in the mortal realm, then he'd be a failure times two.

say:29:1411404029:1.text: We've been watching over Baelran's "retirement" for a while without acting, but things have changed.
say:29:1411404029:1.source_cn: 我们已经旁观巴赫朗休息了许久，但如今已经不同了。

say:30:1411404030:1.text: The Hypogeans have returned. It's time for him to come out of retirement. We've been trying to remind him of this.
say:30:1411404030:1.source_cn: 恶魔重现于世，他的休假也应当结束了，这才是我们提醒他的原因。

say:32:1411404031:1.text: Well, maybe your reminders are a bit too... over... overbeer... loud!
say:32:1411404031:1.source_cn: 呃，话是这么说，你们的提醒也有点太尖锐——

say:34:1411404032:0.text: Wait, Magister. Did you just hear that?
say:34:1411404032:0.source_cn: 咦，主人，你有没有听到什么声音？
say:34:1411404032:0.male: Wait, Magister. Did you just hear that?
say:34:1411404032:0.female: Wait, Magister. Did you just hear that?

narration:39:14014021:0.text: Due to the earthquake, some frightened monsters burst out of the mine and lunge at you!
narration:39:14014021:0.source_cn: 由于地震，受惊的怪物冲出了矿洞，袭击了你们！
narration:39:14014021:0.male: Due to the earthquake, some frightened monsters burst out of the mine and lunge at you!
narration:39:14014021:0.female: Due to the earthquake, some frightened monsters burst out of the mine and lunge at you!

say:40:1411404027:1.text: You say that, Merlin, but you've always been very responsible with your duties.
say:40:1411404027:1.source_cn: 虽然这么说，但你一直在履行自己的职责，梅林。
say:40:1411404027:1.male: You say that, Merlin, but you've always been very responsible with your duties.
say:40:1411404027:1.female: You say that, Merlin, but you've always been very responsible with your duties.

say:41:1411404028:1.text: Perhaps it's precisely that you've been working so hard on completing your duties that you wish for a break.
say:41:1411404028:1.source_cn: 或许正是因为你一直在努力，所以才会想要休息，梅林。
say:41:1411404028:1.male: Perhaps it's precisely that you've been working so hard on completing your duties that you wish for a break.
say:41:1411404028:1.female: Perhaps it's precisely that you've been working so hard on completing your duties that you wish for a break.

choice:7:0:1.text: So, you're fully aware of Sal'thorin.
choice:7:0:1.male: So, you're fully aware of Sal'thorin.
choice:7:0:1.female: So, you're fully aware of Sal'thorin.

say:42:1411404009:1.text: Of course. Although I don't have all the information, who wouldn't be interested in an isolated underground nation no one knew about?
say:42:1411404009:1.source_cn: 当然，虽然消息并不算完整，但没人不会对一个遗世独立的地...
say:42:1411404009:1.male: Of course. Although I don't have all the information, who wouldn't be interested in an isolated underground nation no one knew about?
say:42:1411404009:1.female: Of course. Although I don't have all the information, who wouldn't be interested in an isolated underground nation no one knew about?

say:43:1411404010:1.text: A culture of magically gifted Wilders mixed with a long-forgotten dwarven civilization is bound to create a unique spark of curiosity.
say:43:1411404010:1.source_cn: 天然擅长魔法、设计与雕刻艺术的绿裔，与拥有悠久文明的矮...
say:43:1411404010:1.male: A culture of magically gifted Wilders mixed with a long-forgotten dwarven civilization is bound to create a unique spark of curiosity.
say:43:1411404010:1.female: A culture of magically gifted Wilders mixed with a long-forgotten dwarven civilization is bound to create a unique spark of curiosity.

choice:7:1:2.text: Are you interested in the city?
choice:7:1:2.male: Are you interested in the city?
choice:7:1:2.female: Are you interested in the city?

say:4:1411416001:0.text: Oh no—wait, no, this is perfect! Thank goodness you're here, Zanie!
say:4:1411416001:0.source_cn: 不、不好了——不对，太好了！幸好你在这里，祖娅！

say:5:1411416002:0.text: A pointy-eared girl showed up at the mine below and started bombing everything!
say:5:1411416002:0.source_cn: 下头矿区来了个尖耳朵小丫头，突然就开始到处乱炸！

say:6:1411416003:1.text: What? She's trying to sabotage our mines?
say:6:1411416003:1.source_cn: 怎么回事？下面矿区出事了？有人在搞破坏？

say:7:1411416004:0.text: Not really. She was fine at first, all chatty and nice. Then she just started throwing bombs out of nowhere.
say:7:1411416004:0.source_cn: 也不是搞破坏，一开始她还好好的，突然就开始扔炸弹。

say:8:1411416005:0.text: All those booms and rumbles? That was her.
say:8:1411416005:0.source_cn: 刚刚你们听见轰隆隆的声音了吗？就是她干的。

say:11:1411416007:0.text: What did she look like? What kind of bombs did she use? Did you two get into an argument or something?
say:11:1411416007:0.source_cn: 二位，你们说的那个小姑娘，她长什么样子？是怎样的炸弹？...

say:12:1411416008:0.text: We're not sure either. She's about your height.
say:12:1411416008:0.source_cn: 呃，你这么问我们也搞不清楚，就是你们长身人的那样子。

say:13:1411416009:0.text: She looks like those tall, pointy-eared folk.
say:13:1411416009:0.source_cn: 我觉得和那帮尖耳朵挺像的，有鼻子有眼睛，个子高高耳朵尖...

say:14:1411416010:0.text: I don't remember how her nose was. Maybe normal, maybe not...
say:14:1411416010:0.source_cn: 具体鼻子眼睛怎么摆的，我们也看不清楚啊。

say:15:1411416011:0.text: We weren't fighting. Someone said something, then she got mad.
say:15:1411416011:0.source_cn: 而且也没冲突，就是不知道谁说了两句，她突然就生气了。

say:16:1411416012:0.text: Her bombs were round and black, I guess. Oh, she was talking to one of her bombs. Strange...
say:16:1411416012:0.source_cn: 炸弹，就是黑黑的，圆圆的——对了，她还跟她的炸弹说话呢！

say:18:1411416013:1.text: Most dwarves don't really tell "tall folk" apart, so we don't pay that much attention to them.
say:18:1411416013:1.source_cn: 大部分矮人都分不清长身人的模样，所以也通常没什么戒心。

say:19:1411416014:1.text: Okay, based on what we've heard, she's a young girl who throws bombs when upset and can even talk to them.
say:19:1411416014:1.source_cn: 长相就姑且当做是少女的样子，但是突然生气，扔炸弹，和炸...

say:20:1411416015:0.text: This may be more serious than I expected. We need to hurry below.
say:20:1411416015:0.source_cn: 祖娅，事情很可能比预想得更严重，我们赶紧下去。

say:22:1411416016:0.text: Alright, you two, come with me and tell everyone to stop working down there.
say:22:1411416016:0.source_cn: 好，你们两个也跟我来，一起组织下面停工。

say:23:1411416017:1.text: Oh, didn't you see her when you came up just now? She left from this side.
say:23:1411416017:1.source_cn: 咦，对了，你们刚刚上来没看到她吗？她刚才从这边离开的。

say:24:1411416018:1.text: No, but I heard a loud boom.
say:24:1411416018:1.source_cn: 没有，但我倒是听见轰隆一声。

say:25:1411416019:1.text: If she's that skilled with bombs, maybe she blasted a new tunnel.
say:25:1411416019:1.source_cn: 她很会用炸弹，估计刚刚又打通了新通道吧。

say:26:1411416020:1.text: She uses bombs randomly underground and even opens her own tunnels... Do you know her, Baelran?
say:26:1411416020:1.source_cn: 在这地下随便动用炸弹，还自己开了新通道……这小姑娘是什...

say:28:1411416021:1.text: It's hard to say. I hope it's not who I think it is.
say:28:1411416021:1.source_cn: 现在还不好说，但我希望不是我认识的那位。

say:29:1411416022:1.text: Let's hurry before she causes more damage.
say:29:1411416022:1.source_cn: 快点走吧，免得再耽搁一会儿，她又做出什么事来。

narration:31:14014023:0.text: The earthquake strikes again! Two miners rush over to Zanie, visibly shaken.
narration:31:14014023:0.source_cn: 地震再次爆发！两个矿工慌慌张张地跑来找祖娅。

say:1:1411428001:1.text: I'm a little curious, Baelran. Don't you think the terms you offered Zanie are a bit too generous?
say:1:1411428001:1.source_cn: 巴赫朗，我有点好奇，你刚刚给祖娅提供的条件，是不是有些...

choice_prompt:2:1411428001.text: I'm a little curious, Baelran. Don't you think the terms you offered Zanie are a bit too generous?
choice_prompt:2:1411428001.source_cn: 巴赫朗，我有点好奇，你刚刚给祖娅提供的条件，是不是有些太优厚了啊？

say:3:1411428002:0.text: I do have my fair share of charitable work, but rest assured, the deal I just made wasn't an act of kindness.
say:3:1411428002:0.source_cn: 我确实有自己的慈善事业，不过我可以保证，刚刚的口头合约...
say:3:1411428002:0.male: I do have my fair share of charitable work, but rest assured, the deal I just made wasn't an act of kindness.
say:3:1411428002:0.female: I do have my fair share of charitable work, but rest assured, the deal I just made wasn't an act of kindness.

say:4:1411428004:1.text: If being a considerate business partner and refraining from excessive profit-seeking is considered generous, then it seems that the business practices of today are a bit harsh.
say:4:1411428004:1.source_cn: 如果“体谅生意伙伴”“不追求极端剥削性的利润”就属于优...

say:5:1411428005:0.text: Yes, but that being said, most people would choose to walk away to minimize risk.
say:5:1411428005:0.source_cn: 话是这么说，但大部分人为了规避风险也会放弃啊。

say:6:1411428006:0.text: You're not worried about the risks, and you don't care about profits. I'm starting to think you're not a serious businessman.
say:6:1411428006:0.source_cn: 像你这样又不在意风险，对利润也说让就让，感觉不怎么认真呢……

say:7:1411428007:1.text: Yes, well, Elijah and Lailah always say that when it comes to business or being a Celestial, I'm subpar at best.
say:7:1411428007:1.source_cn: 啊，这一点伊莱亚和莱拉也经常说，做生意和当半神都是不上...

say:8:1411428008:0.text: Still, I believe that in all things, moderation is key. It makes life easier, not just for others, but for yourself as well.
say:8:1411428008:0.source_cn: 不过，我还是觉得，无论做什么事都不要太极端，这样对人对...

choice_prompt:9:1411428008.text: Still, I believe that in all things, moderation is key. It makes life easier, not just for others, but for yourself as well.
choice_prompt:9:1411428008.source_cn: 不过，我还是觉得，无论做什么事都不要太极端，这样对人对己都更轻松。

say:10:1411428009:1.text: Well, among all the other Celestials I've met, I might be the only one who sees things this way.
say:10:1411428009:1.source_cn: 是的，至少在认识的半神里，应该只有我一个人这么想。
say:10:1411428009:1.male: Well, among all the other Celestials I've met, I might be the only one who sees things this way.
say:10:1411428009:1.female: Well, among all the other Celestials I've met, I might be the only one who sees things this way.

say:11:1411428011:0.text: What changed me was the brutality of the Divine War...
say:11:1411428011:0.source_cn: 要说产生这个想法的契机，应该还是惨烈的神魔大战吧。

say:12:1411428012:1.text: Among us Celestials, the war left its mark. Some grew to hate the Hypogeans even more, while others chose to keep that bitterness quietly locked away.
say:12:1411428012:1.source_cn: 只说我们半神，在战后，有人对恶魔的憎恶愈发强烈，也有人...

say:13:1411428013:1.text: I found myself utterly spent, both physically and mentally. At that point, all I wished for was peace.
say:13:1411428013:1.source_cn: 不过我就是身心俱疲，因此反而不愿意多去思考，只想休息了。

say:14:1411428014:0.text: That explains why you're retired. So, business and charity are just pastimes for you now?
say:14:1411428014:0.source_cn: 怪不得你说自己是退休，所以做生意和慈善对你来说是消遣？

say:15:1411428015:0.text: Yes, a little bit. I mostly just let things unfold naturally. Earning a profit is nice, but the real joy comes when I get to help someone along the way.
say:15:1411428015:0.source_cn: 是啊，基本上也是顺其自然，有盈利固然好，但能帮到别人也...

choice_prompt:16:1411428015.text: Yes, a little bit. I mostly just let things unfold naturally. Earning a profit is nice, but the real joy comes when I get to help someone along the way.
choice_prompt:16:1411428015.source_cn: 是啊，基本上也是顺其自然，有盈利固然好，但能帮到别人也算是意外之喜。

say:17:1411428016:2.text: Once this is all settled, I'll likely return to my glamorous life as a part-time investor and wannabe philanthropist.
say:17:1411428016:2.source_cn: 等眼下的事结束后，多半还是会回去继续我那半吊子的事业吧。
say:17:1411428016:2.male: Once this is all settled, I'll likely return to my glamorous life as a part-time investor and wannabe philanthropist.
say:17:1411428016:2.female: Once this is all settled, I'll likely return to my glamorous life as a part-time investor and wannabe philanthropist.

say:18:1411428017:1.text: But as a Celestial, I have a responsibility to uphold. To ignore the Hypogean now, when she stands before me, would be a grave neglect of duty.
say:18:1411428017:1.source_cn: 不过如今，我姑且身为半神，也有自己应尽的职责，恶魔出现...
say:18:1411428017:1.male: But as a Celestial, I have a responsibility to uphold. To ignore the Hypogean now, when she stands before me, would be a grave neglect of duty.
say:18:1411428017:1.female: But as a Celestial, I have a responsibility to uphold. To ignore the Hypogean now, when she stands before me, would be a grave neglect of duty.

say:19:1411428018:1.text: And besides, it's a reunion with our dear old Merlin! Why don't we team up again, celebrate, and pick up right where we left off?
say:19:1411428018:1.source_cn: 再说，这不是还与亲爱的梅林重逢了吗，作为庆祝，联手重操...
say:19:1411428018:1.male: And besides, it's a reunion with our dear old Merlin! Why don't we team up again, celebrate, and pick up right where we left off?
say:19:1411428018:1.female: And besides, it's a reunion with our dear old Merlin! Why don't we team up again, celebrate, and pick up right where we left off?

choice_prompt:20:1411428018.text: And besides, it's a reunion with our dear old Merlin! Why don't we team up again, celebrate, and pick up right where we left off?
choice_prompt:20:1411428018.source_cn: 再说，这不是还与亲爱的梅林重逢了吗，作为庆祝，联手重操旧业如何？
choice_prompt:20:1411428018.male: And besides, it's a reunion with our dear old Merlin! Why don't we team up again, celebrate, and pick up right where we left off?
choice_prompt:20:1411428018.female: And besides, it's a reunion with our dear old Merlin! Why don't we team up again, celebrate, and pick up right where we left off?

say:21:1411428019:1.text: Yes, I can't wait to enjoy our next battle.
say:21:1411428019:1.source_cn: 棒极了，我已经迫不及待地打算享受接下来的战斗了。
say:21:1411428019:1.male: Yes, I can't wait to enjoy our next battle.
say:21:1411428019:1.female: Yes, I can't wait to enjoy our next battle.

say:22:1411428021:1.text: Besides, no matter how you look at her, Kulu is still a little girl.
say:22:1411428021:1.source_cn: 而且，那个库露露……怎么看都只是个小丫头。

say:23:1411428022:0.text: So, let's not overthink this. We'll find her and resolve the issue calmly. No need for drama.
say:23:1411428022:0.source_cn: 不用太上心，找到人后简简单单地解决掉就好了。

say:25:1411428023:1.text: Lailah, isn't it a dereliction of duty for a Celestial to be soft on Hypogeans?
say:25:1411428023:1.source_cn: 会对恶魔心慈手软的半神，还不算失职吗，莱拉？

say:26:1411428024:0.text: I guess, but compared to a Celestial who completely ignores Hypogeans, being lenient doesn't seem like such a breach of duty.
say:26:1411428024:0.source_cn: 比起对恶魔毫不上心的半神来说，或许不算失职吧，伊莱亚。

say:27:1411428025:0.text: Fine, I'm sorry, alright? I just think that little girl is a bit too weak to be lumped in with the rest of the Hypogeans.
say:27:1411428025:0.source_cn: 好了好了，我道歉，我道歉，我只是觉得那小丫头在恶魔里也...

say:28:1411428026:0.text: Since she poses no real threat and Merlin is with us, there's no need to worry too much about the enemy.
say:28:1411428026:0.source_cn: 既然没什么威胁，又有梅林坐镇，就不必太如临大敌。
say:28:1411428026:0.male: Since she poses no real threat and Merlin is with us, there's no need to worry too much about the enemy.
say:28:1411428026:0.female: Since she poses no real threat and Merlin is with us, there's no need to worry too much about the enemy.

say:34:1411430001:0.text: How dare you guys mock me?!
say:34:1411430001:0.source_cn: 你、你们！你们居然敢这么嘲笑我！

say:35:1411430002:1.text: Who are you calling <shk>weak</shk>?! And what do you mean "<shk>no real threat</shk>"?! You really think you can <shk>take me down that easy</shk>?!
say:35:1411430002:1.source_cn: 什么叫<shk>弱！</shk>什么叫<shk>没有威...
say:35:1411430002:1.male: Who are you calling <shk>weak</shk>?! And what do you mean "<shk>no real threat</shk>"?! You really think you can <shk>take me down that easy</shk>?!
say:35:1411430002:1.female: Who are you calling <shk>weak</shk>?! And what do you mean "<shk>no real threat</shk>"?! You really think you can <shk>take me down that easy</shk>?!

say:36:1411430003:1.text: <shk>Ahhh!</shk> I want to kill you all! You're dead!
say:36:1411430003:1.source_cn: <shk>啊啊啊——我生气了！我生气了！</shk>我...

choice_prompt:37:1411430003.text: <shk>Ahhh!</shk> I want to kill you all! You're dead!
choice_prompt:37:1411430003.source_cn: <shk>啊啊啊——我生气了！我生气了！</shk>我绝对不会放过你们！

say:38:1411430004:1.text: I'm writing down everything you guys said! This is evidence!
say:38:1411430004:1.source_cn: 是你们先说我坏话！我肯定会记下来的！这是证据！
say:38:1411430004:1.male: I'm writing down everything you guys said! This is evidence!
say:38:1411430004:1.female: I'm writing down everything you guys said! This is evidence!

say:39:1411430006:1.text: Do I look like some mortal to you?! I'm a powerful Hypogean! I'll never forgive anyone who snubs me, let alone people who spread this... this... What's the word I'm looking for?
say:39:1411430006:1.source_cn: 我这样伟大的恶魔，绝对不会放过一星半点的仇恨，更不要说...

say:42:1411430008:1.text: Yes, slander! I've already written down all the things you were saying behind my back. It's time for me to get revenge!
say:42:1411430008:1.source_cn: 对！你们背后的诋毁，我已经记下了！我必须要狠狠复仇！

choice_prompt:43:1411430008.text: Yes, slander! I've already written down all the things you were saying behind my back. It's time for me to get revenge!
choice_prompt:43:1411430008.source_cn: 对！你们背后的诋毁，我已经记下了！我必须要狠狠复仇！

say:44:1411430009:1.text: No, I'm not as trashy as you dweebs! I'm a stand-up Hypogean!
say:44:1411430009:1.source_cn: 我才没有你们这么阴暗！我可是堂堂正正的凶暴恶魔！
say:44:1411430009:1.male: No, I'm not as trashy as you dweebs! I'm a stand-up Hypogean!
say:44:1411430009:1.female: No, I'm not as trashy as you dweebs! I'm a stand-up Hypogean!

say:45:1411430010:1.text: I'm going to do evil, awful things to you. You'll suffer horribly! My revenge will be tortuous!
say:45:1411430010:1.source_cn: 我会用恶魔的方式，邪恶！凶暴！强大地向你们复仇！
say:45:1411430010:1.male: I'm going to do evil, awful things to you. You'll suffer horribly! My revenge will be tortuous!
say:45:1411430010:1.female: I'm going to do evil, awful things to you. You'll suffer horribly! My revenge will be tortuous!

say:46:1411430011:1.text: Lady Kulu, do you mean torturous...? Oh, never mind...
say:46:1411430011:1.source_cn: ……库露露大人，强大这个词不是这么用……呃算了。

say:34:1411442009:1.text: It's because the sword cleaved into Kulusta herself first.
say:34:1411442009:1.source_cn: 因为那把圣剑，事实上最先斩碎的是正面迎击的库露丝塔本人。

say:35:1411442010:1.text: If a bomb isn't linked to its creator, it won't detonate right away. That gives you a window to shatter it and dull its power.
say:35:1411442010:1.source_cn: 失去主人存在操控的炸弹无法被即时引爆，只能被同样斩碎，...

say:36:1411442011:1.text: Yes, but you cannot harm Lady Kulu! No way!
say:36:1411442011:1.source_cn: 就是这样！不行，绝对不行！你们不能伤害库露露大人！

say:38:1411442012:1.text: Enough, Boomboom! Whoever's at fault needs to take responsibility!
say:38:1411442012:1.source_cn: 够了！阿爆，一人做事一人当！

say:39:1411442013:1.text: I caused this mess, so it should be me who gets cut in half!
say:39:1411442013:1.source_cn: 我已经闯了这么大的祸了，就算被砍碎不也合情合理吗！

say:40:1411442014:1.text: I can't hold on anymore. Hey, old man! Hurry up and do what you need to do!
say:40:1411442014:1.source_cn: 我快撑不住了……喂，老头子！要做什么就快一点！

say:41:1411442015:1.source_cn: ……你比库露丝塔，某种意义上倒还更疯狂一些。
